title: Consolidate duplicated COSE_ALG_LABEL/COSE_KID_LABEL constants (4 modules)
description: Left out of scope of project-LICHEN-worker6-r18i: COSE_ALG_LABEL = 1 and COSE_KID_LABEL = 4 are defined independently in python/src/lichen/crypto/{capability_announcements,delegation_tokens,key_rotation_attestation,root_dio_signature}.py. Same drift risk class as the SCHNORR48_ED25519_ALG consolidation. Consolidate to a single definition (e.g. schnorr48.py or a small cose.py) and re-run uv run --directory python pytest tests/crypto/.

Old import sites keep working via module re-export: gateway/local_facts.py, group_membership.py, tests. Tests: uv run --directory python pytest tests/crypto/ 727 passed 5 skipped (test_tofu_edge_vectors.py collection error is the pre-existing missing-jsonschema env issue, k9xb); downstream tests/test_capability_announcements.py + tests/gateway/test_local_facts.py + test_slot_claim.py 135 passed; group membership tests 22 passed. 3x delegated codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (no dup defs, no import cycle, re-exports intact), security PASS (alg/kid comparisons value-based, trust flow unchanged), edge PASS (no shadowing/monkeypatch concerns). Landed in commit 7f5ef85c4f — NOTE: swept into a 'chore(beads): worker4 sync' commit by the janitor checkpoint (mislabeled message; content is exactly this consolidation, +9/-24 across the 5 files) — left unamended to avoid disturbing janitor references.
